title: 65:10 Sharon/Achor. Sharon, on the west, was the coastal plain from Carmel south to Joppa (33:9; 35:2) The Israelites marched through the valley of Achor (perhaps the Wadi Qelt), on the east, to get from Jericho to Judah (Josh. 7:24; 15:7). This expression means that the whole land from east to west will become a place of safety and refuge for the Lord's people (Hosea 2:15).
author: Tina M. Peterson
